android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION allows you to use Wi-Fi hotspots and / or mobile data to determine the approximate location of a device. The API provides location information accurate to roughly a city block. The search for bluetooth devices was added to the same resolution. The application requests and uses this permission only on the Bluetooth device selection form when setting up the application for a new printer. See Connection FAQ. The program can function without this permission.
Required to be able to connect to paired Bluetooth devices.
The application uses a background service to send data to the printer. The operating system stops the service if the notification is not displayed.

This message means that the driver wanted to show an error window or virtual printer, but the operating system has forbidden it. Go to the settings section. Required permissions.

If you are setting up the printer for the first time, then pay attention. Not all printers are created equal. Thermal printing is only a technology for transferring images to paper. And the devices using it are very different from each other. The program works on the ESC / POS protocol. Other drivers will be added whenever possible.

android.permission.INTERNET - Allows applications to open network sockets. This permission is required for any network activity, including connecting to a network printer on the local network. A simple browser is built into the application for printing web pages. The API of the application allows you to set the task of downloading and printing a file from the Internet.
A support topic in Russian exists on the 4pda.ru forum.

In concern about the battery life of the phone without recharging, phone manufacturers often impose their own additional restrictions on the work in the background. Unfortunately, there is a lot of variety in the settings. I cannot describe more than a dozen different options for how they implemented this in their settings.

The program sends a special command to the printer to exit the Chinese letters mode. If the printer does not understand this command, then while it is in the Chinese alphabet mode, the selection of the code page does not work. Download the setup utility from the printer manufacturer\'s website.
Chinese letters instead of characters in your language.
Set the default encoding to Cp437 or immediately the desired encoding for your language.
The main reason is the printer\'s factory default settings.

Color printing is not supported. The program is designed to work with thermal printers. Ordinary thermal paper changes color when heated. Those. there may be a dot on the paper the color of the paper or a dot after heating. The paper is white, yellow, blue, pink. After heating, the paper may turn black, blue, red. But in most cases it is still only two colors. White paper is most commonly found, which darkens when heated. Unfortunately, not all thermal printers can print even in two shades, and special thermal paper is required that is more expensive than usual. RawBt only supports monochrome printing.
Most often, a bluetooth device can only be paired with one phone or computer. Check that it is not connected to another device. See also \'general\' at the top of the page.
The problem may arise due to the prohibition of showing windows on top of others. See the settings section. Required permissions.
PIN code is wrong / I don’t know pin

1) Try 0000 and 1234. 2) Press the buttons on the printer to print a printer self-test page. Sometimes the PIN code is present in the output. 3) Download the setup utility from your printer manufacturer. Connect to your computer via USB. Use the utility to assign a new one.
Printer manufacturers often only target computers or laptops. That is, your printer is designed for ports with 500mV or higher.
The case when the printer works with the phone via USB can be called a miracle. There are a lot of reasons why it probably won\'t work.
Take a regular USB mouse to test. When connected, the cursor should appear on the screen.
There is no permission to work with the device

For security purposes, the device receives a new identifier every time it connects. That is, if you have poor cable contact, then when the connection is restored, you will need to give permission again. It is possible to set up automatic granting of permissions, but only for one of the programs on the phone. When the printer is connected, a dialog is shown.

Although the printer is connected via a USB connector, virtualization of older physical ports is used for exchange. Previously, printers were connected via LPT or COM. Use the configuration utility provided by the printer manufacturer to select the LPT protocol.
My printer is listed twice. Which to choose ?
This is possible if the printer supports two Bluetooth profiles (normal and BLE - low energy). Go for the regular one.

In theory, knowing the names of bluetooth devices near you, you can determine your location. Android developers were reinsured and banned the search for bluetooth devices at the same time disabling geolocation. Even a new api for pairing with accompanying bluetooth devices also requires hellocation. If you are worried about your privacy or the setting is deep in the menu (for example, like in AndroidTV), then you can pair the device with the regular way and select it from the list. Permission is only required to simplify the configuration process. The program will work without it.
Why does RawBT require bluetooth to be enabled?

This is how Android works. You can get a list of already connected devices only when the bluetooth adapter is connected. It is advisable not to forget to turn on the bluetooth before starting to work with the application. In older versions of android there is a problem with displaying errors that occurred in the background service.
Why am I seeing other devices not printers?

Determining the purpose of the device does not work stably. The printer manufacturer might not have specified it. Native printer drivers usually determine the required devices by their characteristics (by the mask of the mac address or device name, and others).

Check that the application is not restricted from accessing the network. The restriction can be introduced by programs to save Internet traffic or remove ads, as well as additional settings for programs by the phone manufacturer (proprietary add-ons over Android like MIUI). Check with your network administrator.
Try disconnecting from WiFi and reconnecting.

Thermal printing is used in various devices. Depending on the purpose or manufacturer, the printer understands a specific set of commands for transmitting data. Most of the receipt printers understand one of the modifications of the ESC / POS protocol. The situation with label printers is much worse (there are a lot of different, incompatible sets of commands). I am working on expanding the list of supported protocols. Check that your printer is compatible with the supported application protocols.

If you have other programs working with the printer, make sure that they are not currently using the device. Often, to speed up the work, programs are connected to the printer in advance and the device is not available to others. I don\'t know how to programmatically define such a situation.
Depending on the selected connection method, specific problems may arise.
The program assumes that your printer is on and ready to receive commands correctly. After an error, the printer may interpret new commands as part of the data for a previously incomplete command.
There may have been a crash in the android system libraries. Try to re-initialize the transport. Turn off and on again the bluetooth / wifi adapter, disconnect / reconnect the USB cable.
Check: 1. The printer is turned on. 2. The printer does not show an error with its bulbs. 3. No paper problems.

Some printers have an unpleasant feature. If there are already characters in the line buffer, the command to print graphics is not recognized by the printer and is interpreted as text. Characters may have been left over from a previous print job. Therefore, after errors, I recommend turning off and on the printer.
The symbols in the middle of the picture
Try other commands for printing graphics. For most printers, the first two items from the list of those implemented in the application are suitable.

The printer prints by heating. The more dark dots in a line, the more power is required from the battery. When the battery charge is low and the required heating current is high, the voltage may drop below a critical value and the printer electronics will turn off for a short time.
Charge the battery, check the health of the power supply.

If there is no problem with the power supply, the printer manufacturer has overestimated the specifications of the printer. The actual characteristics of the thermal head and those written in the printer\'s firmware do not match.
Doesn\'t print the last lines of a long document

Upon completion of sending data, RawBT is disconnected from the printer. At the moment of shutdown, data output to paper stops. To solve the problem, you need to configure data flow control. Find the optimal ratio of the delay in seconds before disconnecting and waiting in milliseconds between sending chunks of data.

When printing for a long time, when printing an image with large black coverage, at high ambient temperatures, or when heated by sunlight, the thermal protection may be activated. Thermal protection is designed to prevent damage to the printer.
When it cools down, the printer can continue to work.

The reason is an overflow of the printer\'s internal buffer due to the fact that data is sent to the printer faster than it can process it. Watch the video on using the \'Flow control\' settings section
Doesn\'t print part of the document
There are several reasons why printing stops earlier than needed.
In case of an error, I recommend turning the printer off and on again. Why ?

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE - This permission allows background services to start. Additional restrictions are imposed on the operation of services. The service must be accompanied by a visible notification. If you disable / disallow notifications, then the services will be automatically stopped by the operating system.
Increase the size of the letters in the original document so that there are 30–32 letters per line for body text. The print driver should not reformat the text.
For the program to work properly, it is vital that the program can display notifications.
If you have network problems only in my application, then check that you have not set the ban in the system settings.

There are three sides involved in the printing process. The program that wants to print. Android print service. Printer driver (my program). To make sure that the problem is related to my driver, try choosing a different printer or standard printing in a pdf file. Even experienced developers can make mistakes. There were such cases with Chrome and the standard Android System WebView component.

To answer this question, it is important to clarify what type of printing we are talking about. If the letters were sent to the program via the clipboard or you shared a file with the .txt extension, then in this case we have an honest text (bytes encoded in UTF-8). Such text is also called plain text. The program translates the received bytes into the desired code page. The printer independently makes their image using the built-in character generator. Inside the printer, a letter is described as an array of dots. At a minimum, the printer can print in font A (24 dots high by 12 dots wide). You can only resize letters by specifying double height and / or width.

In most cases, what looks like text is in fact a picture for the program. For example, you decided to print a text image from your browser. The browser made a pdf file from the page. I sent it to the print service. You have specified the RawBT printer as the recipient. We pressed the button with the printer. And only at that moment the operating system began to work with my application. I gave her this pdf file and the number of copies that you indicated. For my program, this task looks like a set of pictures that need to be printed as best as possible using all the points of the thermal head. That is, there are no letters for the program, but there is a ready-made picture of the page.

You can choose different paper widths. The narrower the paper, the larger the letters will be. You cannot just increase the letters, the appearance of the page after such an action will become unpredictable.

Answers to frequently asked questions about license restrictions, purchasing a license, problems with payment, and other related questions.
What are the differences between the free version and the paid version?

Print quality, connectivity, and virtually all features work the same. Do not buy a license if your printer does not print. This means that your printer is not supported. The license does not affect this.

In the free version, when using the premium function, the text described in the question above is added. When working with the program, you may come across notices that you cannot add more than one directory or select your logo, or some information is hidden from view. In all these cases, there is an explicit indication that this is a premium feature.
Can a free feature become paid in the future?

The license can only be purchased through google Play. There are no other options. If you don\'t have Google services on your phone, I can\'t help you yet. The problem is that I do not have my own license check server. All purchases are anonymous for me. My program uses an outdated billing library. During this summer, I have to replace it with the current version. Most likely, in this case, I will have to implement my server side. I\'ll try to come up with something.

The time of using the free version is not limited. You can buy the paid version for a period of one month to a year. After the expiration of the paid version, the program will return to the free mode. If you do not need paid features in the future, you can continue using the program in free mode.
How many documents are allowed to be printed?
There is no limitation on the number of documents. You can use the minimum free set of functions for an unlimited time and number of times.

If less than 48 hours have passed since the moment of payment, then you can do it yourself.

If you write me an e-mail with such a request, then the subject of the letter should be in English and begin with the words Refund RawBT, and in the body of the letter indicate the order number (purchase code GPA.x - x - x - x) from the Google Play receipt.
The program used to work correctly with your printer. You bought new paper. The print is faint or the paper comes out clean from the printer.

You can try the following yourself. Take a screenshot of the document page. Reduce the width to 384 points. Convert the image to a 2-color palette (black and white). Notice how the edges of the letters change. They will become angular. The fact is that font smoothing technology is used on the phone or computer screen. The black line is smoothed with dots with different shades of gray.

Permissions are normal security levels and are automatically granted by the operating system as they are listed in the program manifest.

android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE - Allows applications to access information about networks. Used to display the IP address of your phone in print server mode when the device is connected to a network. Enable service: Settings - Additional services - LanShare on 9100
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE - Allows applications to access information about Wi-Fi networks. Used in the same way as ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE when connecting to a wireless network via WiFi.
com.android.vending.BILLING - Purchase a license. Permission is granted automatically. You must have Google Play services on your phone.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH - Allows applications to connect to paired bluetooth devices.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN - Allows applications to discover and pair bluetooth devices.
om.android.providers.tv.permission.READ_EPG_DATA, com.android.providers.tv.permission.WRITE_EPG_DATA - Two permissions for AndroidTV. Needed to create quick access options from the main menu screen.
android.permission.USB_PERMISSION - Allows receiving information about connecting USB devices. Additional permission is required to operate the printer. See the help section \'Connection Problems\'

Thermal printing technology has a number of limitations that affect image quality. The laser printer can apply 2,400 units of ink per inch to paper. The size of such a point is not distinguishable by the human eye. To put it simply, a laser printer can print 600 dots with 255 shades of gray. The best thermal printers can do 300dpi. The main difference is that all dots are of the same color. As a result of heating, the thermal paper changes its color. Depending on the type of chemical element used in production, the paper becomes one of the colors (black, blue and others). The quality of papermaking has a big impact.
